title: MPPSC State Service Exam SSE 2025 Mains Admit Card – Out
vacancyDetails: Mains admit card for MPPSC State Service Exam 2025
qualification: Graduation as per MPPSC SSE notification
documentsRequired: Application number / password; printed mains admit card and photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mppsc.mp.gov.in
2. Open Admit Card / SSE 2025 Mains link
3. Login and download admit card
4. Print and carry to exam centre
shortDescription: MPPSC SSE 2025 Mains Admit Card is out. Download from mppsc.mp.gov.in.
content:
MPPSC has released the State Service Exam (SSE) 2025 Mains Admit Card.

Qualified Prelims candidates should download the mains hall ticket from the official MPPSC website and follow exam-day instructions.
